name: Princess of Thorns
source:
A princess who sleeps in a castle surrounded by thorns. Only a kiss filled to the brim with true love by a prince of destiny will awaken her from her slumber.

[From [url=https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000004727.000001719.html]PR Times[/url]]
